body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'Surfaces 2009') -- <Visual News> Daltile introduced its glazed porcelain floor tile 'Metal Effects' at Surfaces 2009 in Las Vegas from Feb. 3-5.

Metal Effects is a glazed porcelain floor tile that boasts the video color tones and dramatic movement of oxidized metal, but with the durability and easy maintenance advantages of porcelain tile. Its four rich colors are available in four rectified, modular field tile sizes, as well as a 1" x 2" mesh-mounted mosaic brick straight joint pattern-all with an unpolished finish and stylish square edges.
